notes:
PlaneSite 2.0.3:
- Fixes processing stopping with "The EPSG code is unknown ... proj.db ... comes from another PROJ installation". Another mapping program on the computer (for example XGEOMapper) had pointed the whole computer at its own, older copy of the coordinate-system database. PlaneSite now always uses its own.
- Also in this update (2.0.2): publishing a map that's already on GitHub uploads only new or changed tiles, and asks before a re-made map would double the repository's size.
